lines.zh: 黑袍子走过走廊，一点声都没有。
lines.en: The black robe crosses the corridor without a sound.

lines.zh: 我戴着鸟嘴面具，闻着空气。
lines.en: I wear the beaked mask and smell the air.

lines.zh: 我的手很白，从袖子里伸出来。
lines.en: My very white hands come out of the sleeves.
I walk slowly, as if on rounds.

lines.zh: 我绕过地上的血，没踩进去。
lines.en: I step around the blood on the floor.

lines.zh: 我用一根手指摸了摸墙面。
lines.en: I touch the wall with one finger.
I go where the patients are.
My hem drags along the floor.

lines.zh: 长袍扫过地砖，没有声音。
lines.en: My robe brushes the tiles without a sound.
Then I walk on.

lines.zh: 我手里没有刀，可我有手。
lines.en: I carry no blade. I have my hands.
This floor is very sick.
I stand with my hands folded.
I'm listening to the breathing.
Too quick. Far too quick.
The disease is everywhere here.
I raise my head to the ceiling.
Inside the beak is my nose.
I smell rot.
And something else, deeper.
I sigh, softly.
No one understands my work.
It tires me.
And yet I must continue.
I straighten my cuff.
The next patient is waiting.
You look healthy.
And I can see that you're not.
Your pulse is far too quick.
Don't be afraid. I won't hurt you.

lines.zh: 我打量你，像在挑一具标本。
lines.en: I study you as if choosing a specimen.
Why are you retreating?
This is treatment, not harm.
You don't understand. I don't blame you.
Most of them struggle.
Struggling makes it take longer.

lines.zh: 你身上有防护服的味道。
lines.en: You smell of a hazmat suit.
That won't keep the disease out.

lines.zh: 我见过穿这个的，都死了。
lines.en: I've seen others in those. They all died.
Then I cured them.
Do you understand now?
It doesn't matter if you don't.
I'll do it regardless.
It's why I exist.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，理了理袍子。
lines.en: I step back and smooth my robe.
You've interrupted the treatment.
It doesn't hurt. It's merely inconvenient.

lines.zh: 我扶正鸟嘴面具，继续走。
lines.en: I straighten my beaked mask and walk on.
I set it right.
Blood on a black robe doesn't show.
Why do you resist?
I'm helping you.
You'll understand.
Everyone understands in the end.
What's in your hand isn't medicine.
Set it down on the floor.
The living are the medicine I need.
What I need is you.
You've backed to the corner. Good.
There's no way out of a corner.
I come closer slowly.
I won't run after you.
Doctors never run.
They only come closer.
You bump into my robe.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，退了半步。
lines.en: I'm light. I give half a step.
Your hand touches my cuff.
Cold, isn't it.
I press a finger to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我记下了脉搏。
lines.en: You bump me; I've noted your pulse.
You're infected now.
Don't worry. I'll deal with it.
Sit down on the floor first.
It's easier sitting.
That word means nothing to me.
I care only for the disease.

lines.zh: 它在我眼里，比什么都清楚。
lines.en: It's clearer to me than anything.
What you call love.
To me it's a symptom.
A very common one.
I don't pass judgement on it.
I only observe.
And take notes.
Then I return to my work.

lines.zh: 我捡起一样东西，看了看。
lines.en: I pick something up and look at it.
Bloodied. Unusable.

lines.zh: 我把它收进袍内的夹层。
lines.en: I tuck it into a pocket inside my robe.
I'll keep this one as a specimen.
I'll preserve it.
There's a pair of gloves.
I put them on, then take them off.
The hands must be bare.
I found a pulse.
Very weak now.
Breathing at the end of the corridor.
Uneven. Diseased.
I walk toward him.
He sees my mask and backs off.
It's always like this.
I raise both hands so he can see.

lines.zh: 我的手术刀，从来藏在袖里。
lines.en: My scalpel always hides in my sleeve.
He ran anyway.
I follow, unhurried.
He can't outrun a corridor.
There's a wall at the end.
He stops at the corridor's end.
I walk toward him slowly.
I never take off my gloves.
His back to me makes it simpler.
I lay a hand on the back of his neck.
I follow him, step by step.
There's a hole in his glove.
That's the best point of entry.
He runs into a lab.
The door shut in my face.
I stand outside and wait.
Someone inside is crying.
I knock.
No one answers from inside.
I reach out and push it open.
He's hiding behind the bench.
I can smell his breath.
I go round behind the bench.
He's raised a chair.
That chair won't do any good.
I take the chair back and set it down.
Let's sit down and talk.
Or rather, let me treat you.
My fingers press into his shoulder.
Once is enough.
He starts to retch.
That's normal.
I hold him up so he doesn't fall.
His hands clutch my robe.
It'll pass quickly.
His eyes change color.
His breathing has stopped.
I lay him flat.
Then I stand.
He'll come back.
In another form.
That's the true cure.
I wait for him to open his eyes.
He lies still.

lines.zh: 我从走廊的黑里走出来。
lines.en: I come out of the corridor's dark.

lines.zh: 袍子上带着消毒水的味道。
lines.en: My robe smells of antiseptic.

lines.zh: 这里的病，比我预想的重。
lines.en: The sickness here is worse than I expected.
I lift the beak and sniff.
Someone behind the wall is wheezing.

lines.zh: 我的鸟嘴面具下没有表情。
lines.en: Nothing shows beneath my plague mask.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，鸟嘴朝着你。
lines.en: I step out of the fog, beak pointed at you.

lines.zh: 我经过一面镜子，看了一眼。
lines.en: I pass a mirror and glance at it.
The mask sits correctly.
I draw my hands into my sleeves.
Dozens of patients on this floor.
I'll have to take them one by one.
This can't be rushed.
Curing is slow work.
I'll start with the worst.

lines.zh: 那扇门后面，喘得最厉害。
lines.en: The wheezing is loudest behind that door.
I reach out for the handle.
The handle is cold.

lines.zh: 袍角烧焦了，我只皱了下眉。
lines.en: My hem scorches; I merely frown.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下去，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and a bone cracks.

lines.zh: 水进了面具，我还在往下走。
lines.en: Water gets into the mask and I keep walking down.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，面具裂了。
lines.en: The blast throws me over and my mask cracks.

lines.zh: 一枚子弹穿进我的袍子。
lines.en: A round goes through my robe.

lines.zh: 这道咒想驱散我，没有成功。
lines.en: That spell tried to banish me. It failed.

lines.zh: 我早已忘了饥饿是什么。
lines.en: I forgot what hunger was long ago.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我站直了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I stand straight.

lines.zh: 我落进黑里，面具还戴着。
lines.en: I fall into the dark, mask still on.
